title: Every SAT Grammar Rule Explained
description:
Grammar is about a quarter of the SAT Reading and Writing section, and every grammar question comes from the same short list of rules. This video covers all 13, with an SAT-style practice question for most of them.

You'll learn:
• How to spot a complete sentence (the key to every punctuation question)
• Comma splices, semicolons, colons, dashes, and "however"
• Matching pairs of commas and dashes around extra information
• Subject-verb agreement, pronouns, verb tense, and dangling modifiers
• Apostrophes: plurals vs. possessives, its vs. it's
• A 3-step method for any SAT grammar question

All practice questions in this video are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (filter: Standard English Conventions).
